from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors
r=Chem.MolFromSmiles('COc1cccc([Mg+])c1')
s=Chem.MolFromSmiles('O=C1c2ccc(OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F)cc2C(=O)N1Cc1cccnc1')
p=Chem.MolFromSmiles('COc1ccccc1-c1ccc2c(c1)C(=O)N(Cc1cccnc1)C2=O')
print('Grignard canonical:',Chem.MolToSmiles(r))
print('substrate canonical:',Chem.MolToSmiles(s))
print('product canonical:',Chem.MolToSmiles(p))
print('formula:',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(p),'MW:',rdMolDescriptors.CalcExactMolWt(p))
# Locate substrate aryl carbon bonded to triflate O and product corresponding biaryl bond
for a in s.GetAtoms():
    if a.GetSymbol()=='C' and any(n.GetSymbol()=='O' and any(nn.GetSymbol()=='S' for nn in n.GetNeighbors()) for n in a.GetNeighbors()):
        print('substrate electrophilic aryl carbon idx',a.GetIdx(), 'neighbors',[(n.GetIdx(),n.GetSymbol()) for n in a.GetNeighbors()])
# list product biaryl bond aromatic-carbon to aromatic-carbon, unique inter-ring bonds
for b in p.GetBonds():
    x,y=b.GetBeginAtom(),b.GetEndAtom()
    if x.GetSymbol()=='C' and y.GetSymbol()=='C' and x.GetIsAromatic() and y.GetIsAromatic():
        # non-ring aromatic bond is biaryl
        if not b.IsInRing(): print('new C-C bond',x.GetIdx(),y.GetIdx(),b.GetBondType())
